apps.description: Free/Libre Open Source Software Binaries of VS Code. A fully open-source code editor with IntelliSense, debugging, and Git integration.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.description: Music and podcast streaming platform. Discover, manage and share over 80 million tracks for free, or subscribe to Spotify Premium.
